rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: NorthData is an independent community wrapper around the NorthData GmbH API, exposing German corporate registry data — company profiles, ownership structures, and financial records — as MCP tools. A built-in credit guard caps API spending, since NorthData charges per company returned rather than per HTTP call. Not developed or supported by NorthData GmbH.
